prompt: Pan across the group of people walking towards the desert, gentle movement of their clothes.
The glowing cloud pillar gently pulsing with light, slowly moving forward.
The fire pillar flickering and emitting soft glowing sparks into the night sky.
Dust clouds rising in the distance as silhouettes of chariots move closer.
Children crying with subtle trembling motions, people holding each other.
Moses taking a deep breath, looking up with wind gently blowing his white beard and hair.
Strong wind blowing, sea waves crashing and splashing dynamically.
Water swirling and pulling back, revealing the sand underneath.
The sea splitting in half, water rising up like walls on both sides.
Water shimmering on the giant walls, small fishes swimming within the suspended water.
People walking slowly through the path, looking around in amazement.
Chariots racing through the dry path, wheels spinning, horses galloping.
Massive waves crashing down together, splashing high into the air.
